strings.text: The school’s awards page claims "26 BLUMEY Awards," but that figure counts nominations and finalist placements together with wins. Cross-checked against Blumenthal’s published winner lists, exactly one outright win is verifiable — Max Odom, 2022. PD is a consistent participant and a reliable producer of individual acting finalists, not a Blumey powerhouse: in 2025 and 2026 it placed 5–6 finalists each year, converted none, and appeared in no production-level category, while Northwest School of the Arts took three wins in 2026 alone. Its high-water mark was 2016–2022. Where the program does win is NCTC: Superior ratings in 2014, 2019 and 2022; Overall Regional Site Winner (Adjudicators’ Choice) for The Yellow Boat; Regional Site Winner (Audience Choice) for Radium Girls, which advanced to the State Festival and took state-level Lighting and Set Design honors; and Excellence in Directing in both 2023 and 2024.
strings.t: Paj prim lekòl la reklame “26 BLUMEY Awards,” men chif sa a konte nominasyon ak plasman finalis ansanm ak viktwa. Lè nou verifye l kont lis moun ki genyen Blumenthal pibliye yo, egzakteman yon sèl viktwa nèt ki ka verifye — Max Odom, 2022. PD se yon patisipan konsistan ak yon pwodiktè fyab finalis aktyaj endividyèl, se pa yon pisans Blumey: an 2025 ak 2026 li te plase 5–6 finalis chak ane, li pa t konvèti okenn, epi li pa t parèt nan okenn kategori nivo pwodiksyon, pandan Northwest School of the Arts te pran twa viktwa nan sèl ane 2026 la. Pi wo pwen li se te 2016–2022. Kote pwogram nan genyen vre se NCTC: nòt Superior an 2014, 2019 ak 2022; Overall Regional Site Winner (Adjudicators’ Choice) pou The Yellow Boat; Regional Site Winner (Audience Choice) pou Radium Girls, ki te avanse nan State Festival la epi ki te pran onè Lighting ak Set Design nan nivo eta; ak Excellence in Directing an 2023 ak 2024 tou de.

strings.text: Alicia Long heads the performing arts program. The tech track is genuinely articulated and undersold: the backstage/technical course starts in Grade 6 — a year before the acting course — and the Upper School sequence runs Stagecraft I → Stagecraft II → Advanced Design, plus an after-school stagecraft option. It produced a 2025 Blumey nomination for Best Student Stage Manager. For a student who would rather build than perform, this is stronger than most peer schools publish.
strings.t: Alicia Long alatèt pwogram atizay pèfòmans la. Pis teknik la vrèman byen atikile epi yo pa vante l ase: kou dèyè sèn/teknik la kòmanse nan Grad 6 — yon ane anvan kou aktyaj la — epi sekans Upper School la kouri Stagecraft I → Stagecraft II → Advanced Design, plis yon opsyon stagecraft aprè-lekòl. strings.text: A Best Actress Blumey is the single most competitive individual honor in the region, and Latin has one — plus Best Featured Performer the same night. That is a genuine peak. Separately, no NCTC one-act festival results could be found anywhere — Latin’s competitive theatre identity is Blumey-based (musical), not NCTC-based (play festival). This ledger reflects four Blumenthal releases checked in one research pass and is a floor, not a complete history.

strings.text: Richard Fletcher chairs visual arts; no other visual-arts faculty are named anywhere on the school’s pages, which refer only to "a team of dedicated and experienced art educators." Scholastic Art & Writing recognition found: Ella Hennessy ’28 took a GOLD KEY for "Strike" (photography) — the top regional award, which advances to national judging; plus Hope Gottschling ’24 (fashion, "Silk Strength"), Anjali Rao ’27 (fashion, 2023), Cary Mone (oil painting, 2023) and Madison Nabors ’25 (drawing, 2023). Method caveat: those names, titles, media and the Gold Key level are read from image filenames in the school’s page HTML — reliable for identity, but Latin publishes no Scholastic results page with award tiers, so Gottschling’s frequently-cited "honorable mention" level could not be confirmed. The Fab Lab is referenced once in connection with portfolio work but sits under Innovation & Design rather than the arts department; there is no named cross-disciplinary art course, project or equipment list, so it is not presented here as an arts facility.

Rezèv sou metòd: non sa yo, tit yo, medya yo ak nivo Gold Key la li nan non fichye imaj nan HTML paj lekòl la — fyab pou idantite, men Latin pa pibliye okenn paj rezilta Scholastic ak nivo prim, kidonk nou pa t kapab konfime nivo “honorable mention” yo site souvan pou Gottschling. Yo referans Fab Lab la yon fwa an koneksyon ak travay pòtfèy men li chita anba Innovation & Design olye ke anba depatman atizay la; pa gen okenn kou, pwojè oswa lis ekipman ant disiplin ki gen non, kidonk nou pa prezante l isit la kòm yon enstalasyon atistik.

strings.text: The Center for Worship and Performing Arts opened in Fall 2017 as Phase 1 of the master campus plan — two storeys, roughly 20,500–20,800 sq ft, seating 518 per the architect. strings.text: Two audition-only competition teams carry the competitive work: ACT 1 (high school) and ACT 2 (middle school). The tech track is better resourced than the school advertises — technical directing and stage management are two of the seven theatre electives, the venue includes a scene shop and dressing rooms per the contractor, and students place in technical categories externally (a CITA Technical Theatre Costume Design award, plus the 2013 Blumey win for Best Lighting Execution). Caution on personnel: the only theatre staff names findable anywhere date to a 2016 news post — Angela Tomaselli (ACT 1) and Conrad Bear (ACT 2) — and may be stale. No current director or technical director is published, and no faculty are named on any of the four branch pages.
strings.t: De ekip konpetisyon ak odisyon sèlman pote travay konpetitif la: ACT 1 (lekòl segondè) ak ACT 2 (middle school). Atansyon sou pèsonèl: sèl non estaf teyat nou ka jwenn okenn kote gen dat 2016 nan yon piblikasyon nouvèl — Angela Tomaselli (ACT 1) ak Conrad Bear (ACT 2) — epi yo ka ansyen. strings.text: The 2013 Best Musical win is the program’s headline arts achievement and it is confirmed directly by Blumenthal Arts. But there has been no Blumey win, and no top-6 nomination, since — the 2024 Tarzan result is real and impressive as a whole-cast showing, yet it sits one tier below nomination, in a field that had grown from 17 schools to 50. The CITA record is the school’s most distinctive credential because the circuit suits its identity, but it rests on a single published year: 2016. The school describes CITA honors as earned "each year," and that framing has one data point behind it. Separately, no specific NCTC award could be found for any year.
strings.t: Viktwa Best Musical 2013 la se pi gwo reyalizasyon atistik pwogram nan epi Blumenthal Arts konfime l dirèkteman. Men pa gen okenn viktwa Blumey, ak pa gen okenn nominasyon top-6, depi lè sa a — rezilta Tarzan 2024 la reyèl epi enpresyonan kòm yon pèfòmans pou tout distribisyon an, men li chita yon nivo anba nominasyon, nan yon chan ki te grandi soti 17 lekòl rive 50. Dosye CITA a se kalifikasyon ki pi distenktif lekòl la paske sikwi a matche ak idantite l, men li chita sou yon sèl ane ki pibliye: 2016. Lekòl la dekri onè CITA kòm bagay yo genyen “chak ane,” epi chapant sa a gen yon sèl done dèyè l. Apa de sa, nou pa t kapab jwenn okenn prim NCTC espesifik pou okenn ane.

strings.text: Country Day is a consistent, credible Blumey contender rather than a current front-runner: nominated every year from 2022 through 2025, it converted that into zero wins after 2022, then drew a blank in 2026. Its high-water mark is genuinely strong — two wins including Best Direction. Individual performer development looks repeatable rather than lucky: Sabrina McGovern earned lead-category nominations in three consecutive cycles, and five different students placed in five performance categories in 2025. On NCTC, the school claims five state championships, but only one play title could be verified — The Crane Wife, a second consecutive championship, placing it in fall 2018 with the prior title in fall 2017 (title unknown). The other three years and titles could not be found, and Country Day did not place at the 2025 state festival, so all five predate 2025. Treat "five championships" as the school’s claim. The strongest independently verified credential here is about teaching, not trophies: NCTC named Jenny Goodfellow North Carolina’s 2022 K-12 Theatre Arts Educator — confirmed on NCTC’s own awards page. For scale, the NCTC festival draws 3,500+ students from 100+ schools across 130+ productions.
strings.t: Country Day se yon konkiran Blumey konsistan ak kredib olye ke yon lidè aktyèl: yo te nonmen l chak ane soti 2022 rive 2025, li te konvèti sa an zewo viktwa apre 2022, apre sa li pa t jwenn anyen an 2026. Pi wo pwen li vrèman solid — de viktwa ki enkli Best Direction. Devlopman pèfòmè endividyèl sanble repwodiktib olye ke chans: Sabrina McGovern te genyen nominasyon nan kategori prensipal nan twa sik youn dèyè lòt, epi senk elèv diferan te plase nan senk kategori pèfòmans an 2025. Sou NCTC, lekòl la reklame senk chanpyona eta, men nou te ka verifye sèlman yon sèl tit pyès — The Crane Wife, yon dezyèm chanpyona youn dèyè lòt, sa ki mete l nan otòn 2018 ak tit anvan an nan otòn 2017 (tit enkoni). Nou pa t kapab jwenn twa lòt ane yo ak tit yo, epi Country Day pa t plase nan festival eta 2025 la, kidonk tout senk yo anvan 2025. Trete “senk chanpyona” kòm reklamasyon lekòl la. Kalifikasyon ki pi solid ki verifye endepandamman isit la konsène ansèyman, se pa twofe: NCTC te nonmen Jenny Goodfellow K-12 Theatre Arts Educator 2022 North Carolina — konfime sou pwòp paj prim NCTC a. Pou echèl, festival NCTC la atire 3,500+ elèv nan 100+ lekòl atravè 130+ pwodiksyon.

strings.text: Andy Macdonald, Director of Theater Arts since 2012, teaches all three Upper School theater levels and directs both the fall one-acts and the winter musical. Rob Burlington, Director of Music Arts, is music director for the winter musical — so the Blumey-competing show is co-led by the theater and music directors. No technical director is named publicly. The tech story is instead structural: the catwalk above the stage lets students assist on rigging lighting, and the AV control room at the rear of the house was, in the school’s words, "specifically designed for students to assist in the technical side of productions." Note the catalog has no course titled "Acting" or "Stagecraft" despite the website naming them — the real sequence is Honors Theater I, II and Theater in Performance, which can also be entered by doing three company productions instead of the prerequisite.

strings.text: All of it happens in the Cindric Performing Arts Center on the Leck Family thrust stage, which extends into the audience on three sides. strings.text: Two things a parent should hold together. The record is real and consistent — a full sweep of all five performance categories in both 2023 and 2025 — but every located line sits under a "Finalists for…" heading, and no Cannon winner line was found in any year checked. Treat this as ten finalist placements, not ten awards. On NCTC, participation is structural and every-year, but no year-by-year regional placement, state advancement or named award could be found, so no ledger is shown for it — the festival draws 3,500+ students from 100+ schools across 130+ productions, with select plays advancing from regionals to state. The director’s own framing is notably not trophy-focused: he says the judges’ feedback and seeing other schools’ work is what makes the festival special. Blumey involvement appears to reach back to at least 2019, but that page is no longer readable.
strings.t: De bagay yon paran ta dwe kenbe ansanm. Dosye a reyèl epi konsistan — yon bale konplè nan tout senk kategori pèfòmans an 2023 ak 2025 tou de — men chak liy nou jwenn chita anba yon tit “Finalis pou…”, epi nou pa t jwenn okenn liy ki di Cannon te genyen nan okenn ane nou tcheke. Trete sa a kòm dis plasman finalis, se pa dis prim. Sou NCTC, patisipasyon an estriktirèl epi li fèt chak ane, men nou pa t kapab jwenn okenn plasman rejyonal, avansman nan eta oswa prim ki gen non ane pa ane, kidonk nou pa montre okenn lis pou li — festival la atire 3,500+ elèv nan 100+ lekòl atravè 130+ pwodiksyon, ak kèk pyès chwazi k ap avanse soti nan rejyonal rive nan eta. Chapant direktè a li menm remakabman pa konsantre sou twofe: li di se konsèy jij yo ak wè travay lòt lekòl ki fè festival la espesyal. Patisipasyon nan Blumey sanble remonte omwen jiska 2019, men paj sa a pa ka li ankò.

strings.text: Krista Johns directs Visual Art — she joined in 2007, piloted TAB in the Lower School in 2011 and became director in 2022. strings.text: No theatre director, musical director or drama teacher is named in any source, and the catalog does not attribute courses to faculty — notable given the school earned a Best Overall Direction nomination in 2023, which Blumenthal credits to the school rather than an individual. The Theatre Performance Ensemble is a select company; new students must audition, most class time is rehearsal, and there are after-school calls before performances. There is NO stagecraft or technical theatre course in the 2026-27 catalog — the nearest offering, Film Studies & Production, is video editing rather than stage tech. Students clearly build substantial multi-level scenery, and a Davidson Day student once won a scholarship for non-performing theater work, so backstage participation exists in some form; whether through a class, club or crew is unpublished.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn direktè teyat, direktè mizikal oswa pwofesè teyat ki nonmen nan okenn sous, epi katalòg la pa atribye kou bay pwofesè — sa remakab lè w konsidere lekòl la te genyen yon nominasyon Best Overall Direction an 2023, ke Blumenthal bay lekòl la olye ke yon moun. PA GEN okenn kou stagecraft oswa teyat teknik nan katalòg 2026-27 la — ofrann ki pi pre a, Film Studies & Production, se editaj videyo olye ke teknik sèn. Elèv yo klèman bati dekò enpòtan ak plizyè nivo, epi yon elèv Davidson Day te genyen yon bous yon fwa pou travay teyat ki pa nan pèfòmans, kidonk patisipasyon dèyè sèn egziste nan yon fòm; si se atravè yon klas, klib oswa ekip pa pibliye.

strings.text: For a school this small, the Blumey record is real and better than the enrollment would predict — the 2023 nominations for Best Ensemble/Chorus and Best Overall Direction are program-level recognition, not just standout individuals. The flip side of small-school math is the upside for a student: mounting a full musical out of a very small student body means far fewer peers competing for a role. Two things a parent should note plainly: no NCTC participation, placement or award could be found anywhere, so the Blumeys are the whole external picture; and prior research attributing a production of "Matilda Jr." to this school was an error — that show was staged by the Davidson Community Players, a separate community theater company in the same town, so it is excluded here.
strings.t: Pou yon lekòl ki piti konsa, dosye Blumey a reyèl epi li pi bon pase sa enskripsyon an ta predi — nominasyon 2023 yo pou Best Ensemble/Chorus ak Best Overall Direction se rekonesans nan nivo pwogram nan, se pa sèlman moun ki remakab. Lòt bò matematik ti lekòl la se avantaj la pou yon elèv: monte yon mizikal konplè ak yon kò elèv ki piti anpil vle di gen mwens kanmarad k ap konpetisyone pou yon wòl. De bagay yon paran ta dwe note klèman: nou pa t kapab jwenn okenn patisipasyon, plasman oswa prim NCTC okenn kote, kidonk Blumeys yo se tout foto ekstèn la; epi rechèch anvan ki te atribye yon pwodiksyon “Matilda Jr.” bay lekòl sa a se te yon erè — Davidson Community Players, yon konpayi teyat kominotè apa nan menm vil la, te monte pyès sa a, kidonk nou eskli l isit la.

strings.text: No visual arts, photography or AP Studio Art teacher is named in any source. The school states that students building AP portfolios "pursue admission" at schools such as the Savannah College of Art and Design, Rhode Island School of Design and Chapman University — note the careful wording, which describes where students apply rather than confirmed admissions. Whether the school supplies cameras is unpublished, though catalog photos show students with their own DSLR bodies. One adjacent honor worth knowing: sophomore Sims Skaff was named Photographer of the Year in the Private School Journalism Association contest, co-sponsored by Quill and Scroll, announced April 2025 — but that came through the yearbook and journalism pipeline, which the catalog houses under English rather than the arts department.
strings.t: Pa gen okenn pwofesè atizay vizyèl, fotografi oswa AP Studio Art ki nonmen nan okenn sous. Lekòl la deklare elèv k ap bati pòtfèy AP “pouswiv admisyon” nan lekòl tankou Savannah College of Art and Design, Rhode Island School of Design ak Chapman University — note mo yo chwazi ak atansyon, ki dekri kote elèv yo aplike olye ke admisyon konfime. Yo pa pibliye si lekòl la bay kamera, byenke foto katalòg yo montre elèv ak pwòp kò DSLR pa yo. Yon onè akote ki vo lapèn konnen: yo te nonmen Sims Skaff, yon elèv dezyèm ane, Photographer of the Year nan konkou Private School Journalism Association la, ko-patwone pa Quill and Scroll, anonse nan avril 2025 — men sa te vin atravè rezo ane-liv ak jounalis la, ke katalòg la mete anba English olye ke anba depatman atistik la.

strings.text: An accessible arts program, not a conservatory one — with a real Blumey record and a full visual ladder, but almost nothing about it published.
strings.t: Yon pwogram atistik ki aksesib, se pa yon konsèvatwa — ak yon vrè dosye Blumey ak yon nechèl vizyèl konplè, men prèske anyen sou li ki pibliye.

strings.text: A genuine no-audition way into performing music

strings.text: Contemporary Ensemble takes students at any level with no audition, adjusts repertoire to each player, and provides guitars, bass, keyboards and drums in the classroom. For a beginner or late starter that is a materially lower barrier than an auditioned band or choir.
strings.t: Contemporary Ensemble pran elèv nan nenpòt nivo san odisyon, li ajiste repètwa a pou chak jwè, epi li bay gita, bas, klavye ak tanbou nan sal klas la. Pou yon debitan oswa yon moun ki kòmanse ta sa se yon baryè materyèlman pi ba pase yon fanfa oswa koral ak odisyon.

strings.t: lekòl la monte yon mizikal Upper School konplè ak yon kò elèv ki piti anpil, kidonk yon elèv ki vle jwe konpetisyone kont anpil mwens kanmarad pase nan yon gwo lekòl endepandan oswa yon magnet piblik.

strings.t: se sèlman yon kredi bozar ki obligatwa pou gradye, kidonk yon elèv ki pa enterese nan atizay pa fòse nan yon gwo angajman — pandan yon elèv ki angaje nan atizay ka pran kredi PE a pou teyat, sa ki libere yon plas nan orè a.

strings.text: Where do performances actually happen? No arts venue is named anywhere, and catalog photos appear to show a musical staged in the gym and a recital inside the art studio. strings.text: Is there any concert band, orchestra or chorus, in any division at any level? The Upper School catalog shows only Contemporary Ensemble. If my child plays violin or flute, or sings classically, what do they join in grades 9–12?

strings.text: Anna Jernigan’s arc anchors the program: a 2024 Best Actor finalist placement (as Lily in Anastasia, per Blumenthal’s own labeling) became the 2026 Best Actress win for Footloose, which carried on to the national Jimmy Awards. The Honors and AP studio courses appear only in the Course Offerings guide, which the arts page does not corroborate.
strings.t: Evènman galri oswa ekspozisyon High School depase Art Festival Middle School la pa pibliye, epi pa gen okenn rekonesans atizay vizyèl ekstèn (Scholastic oswa lòt) ki parèt nan pas sa a. Kou studio Honors ak AP yo parèt sèlman nan gid Course Offerings la, ke paj atizay la pa korobore.

strings.text: A theatre program with a genuine, recently converted Blumey win, sitting on a leaner music and visual-arts footprint than its regional peers.
strings.t: Yon pwogram teyat ak yon vrè viktwa Blumey ki fèk konvèti, ki chita sou yon anpreyent mizik ak atizay vizyèl ki pi mens pase parèy rejyonal li yo.

strings.text: The 2026 Best Actress win and its Jimmy Awards advancement are the real, verified headline; the open questions are about the undocumented venue, director and honors circuits.
strings.t: Viktwa Best Actress 2026 la ak avansman Jimmy Awards li a se vrè tit ki verifye a; kesyon ki louvri yo se sou lye, direktè ak sikwi onè ki pa dokimante.

strings.text: A verified Blumey win — not just finalists
strings.t: Yon viktwa Blumey verifye — se pa jis finalis

strings.text: Anna Jernigan took Best Actress for "Footloose" at the 2026 Blumey Awards (confirmed by WFAE) and advanced to the national Jimmy Awards — an outright win, converted from her 2024 finalist placement.
strings.t: Anna Jernigan pran Best Actress pou "Footloose" nan Blumey Awards 2026 la (konfime pa WFAE) epi li avanse nan Jimmy Awards nasyonal yo — yon viktwa nèt, konvèti soti nan plasman finalis 2024 li a.

strings.text: Depth behind the win
strings.t: Pwofondè dèyè viktwa a

strings.text: the 2026 "Footloose" run placed six across five categories (actress, actor, both supporting, featured performer and choreography), and "Anastasia" placed seven in 2024 — a repeat producer of acting finalists, not a one-off.
strings.t: kous "Footloose" 2026 la plase sis atravè senk kategori (aktris, aktè, tou de sipò, featured performer ak koreyografi), epi "Anastasia" plase sèt an 2024 — yon pwodiktè finalis aktè repete, se pa yon sèl fwa.

strings.text: Middle School students attend the Christians in Theatre Arts (CITA) Conference and enter the NCTC Spring Play Competition — an early on-ramp to competitive and community theatre.
strings.t: Elèv Middle School yo asiste Konferans Christians in Theatre Arts (CITA) a epi yo antre nan NCTC Spring Play Competition — yon premye antre nan teyat konpetitif ak kominotè.

strings.text: Where do productions like "Footloose" actually stage — what is the venue, and how many seats? The site names a "Main Stage" but no room.
strings.t: Ki kote pwodiksyon tankou "Footloose" vrèman monte — ki lye a, epi konbyen plas? Sit la nonmen yon "Main Stage" men pa gen okenn sal.

strings.text: Who directs the Upper School musical, and who ran the 2026 Blumey-winning "Footloose"? No director is published.
strings.t: Kiyès ki dirije mizikal Upper School la, epi kiyès ki mennen "Footloose" ki genyen Blumey 2026 la? Pa gen okenn direktè ki pibliye.

strings.text: The Course Offerings guide lists Honors Art III/IV, Honors Acting Studio and AP 2-D Art & Design, but the arts page names none of them — which of these actually runs each year?
strings.t: Gid Course Offerings la liste Honors Art III/IV, Honors Acting Studio ak AP 2-D Art & Design, men paj atizay la pa nonmen okenn nan yo — kilès nan sa yo vrèman mache chak ane?

strings.text: Is there any music beyond band, choir and the Ignite praise teams — an orchestra, a strings program, or an a cappella group?
strings.t: Èske gen okenn mizik depase band, choir ak ekip louwanj Ignite yo — yon òkès, yon pwogram kòd, oswa yon gwoup a cappella?

strings.text: What happens at the Middle School "Honor Band" event, and do students audition into any all-state or regional honors ensemble from there?
strings.t: Kisa ki pase nan evènman "Honor Band" Middle School la, epi èske elèv yo fè odisyon nan nenpòt ansanm onè all-state oswa rejyonal apati la?

strings.text: Was the "Singin' in the Rain" Blumey pair (Pisacano, Wilson) a separate year from the 2024 "Anastasia" nominations — and what year was it?
strings.t: Èske pè Blumey "Singin' in the Rain" la (Pisacano, Wilson) te yon ane apa de nominasyon "Anastasia" 2024 yo — epi ki ane li te ye?
